text:
tanya: Heads-up 101 - Saffron's renewal in 2w. Their onboarding dashboard shows repeated tail latency on their embed route (/v1/embeds). We should prepare a short comms + provisional credit calc.
ben: paste the SLO and numbers? need p50/p95/p99 and uptime to draft the calc
tanya: SLA: 99.9% uptime; SLO: 95% < 150ms on /v1/embeds. Last 7d: uptime 99.92%, p50=70ms, p95=310ms, p99=620ms. Rolling 7d has 2 weekdays where p95>150ms.
dave: that's within their contract threshold for a credit trigger (p95 breach >1 business day in 7d). ops can try a transient burst increase + KV prefix cache. low risk.
anna: legal: we need the exact windows and the token counts for the credit formula before sending anything customer-facing. also include remediation evidence so we can reduce credit if effective.
slo-bot: automated: 2025-10-12T11:03Z 1 - p95 exceeded 150ms on 2 days this rolling 7d. incident ticket created CS-2042. link: https://redwood.internal/slo/saffron/7d
tanya: ok action list: 1) ben - run timeseries export + credit calc draft, 2) dave - enable prefix cache canary + capture 6h post-toggle metrics, 3) anna - legal placeholder review, 4) ops - attach traces and autoscale events to ticket. Deadline: EOD tomorrow for CSM review.
ben: working on credit calc. FYI our credit formula = (breach_days / 7) * monthly_commitment * credit_rate. Need total requests in breach windows and average tokens.
dave: quick command I'll run for traces:
```
redwood metrics query --service inference --route "/v1/embeds" --since 7d --agg p95,p99,p50 --by day
redwood traces list --filter "route=='/v1/embeds' AND latency>200" --limit 20
```
I'll attach top 5 traces and scaling events. scheduling canary at 01:00 UTC tonight.
ben: I'll compute provisional credit with two scenarios: (A) no remediation applied; (B) remediation reduces breach days by X -> adjusted credit. will include a short 1-paragraph explanation for the customer.
anna: legal requests explicit text for "provisional" language: must make clear credits are subject to final verification; include timeline and rollback clause. I'll add bullets in the doc.
saffron-customer: @tanya we can run a 20min synthetic at 03:00 UTC if that helps validate warmup. happy to coordinate.
tanya: perfect, please confirm the window. we'll pause final credit claim pending post-warmup metrics (48h).
dave: canary toggle done at 01:05 UTC. posted initial metrics 6h after: p95 dropped from 310ms to 160ms in canary group, overall route p95 improved 12%. attaching graphs to CS-2042.
ben: draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/cs/drafts/saffron-credit-provisional. includes spreadsheet with daily tokens and breach windows + provisional credit amounts.
anna: reviewed doc, updated provisional language and added legal signoff checkbox.
tanya: great. next steps: 1) review draft with CSM, 2) if customer synthetic confirms warmup effect, we propose reduced credit in final comms, 3) otherwise present standard credit. i'll assemble final bundle and route to legal for approval by tomorrow noon. any blockers?
dave: none from infra. will keep monitoring 24-48h.
ben: will add a short FAQ for the customer on why tails happen and our mitigation steps.
tanya: thanks team. closing note: flagging renewal risk as "monitoring" not "high" given quick remediate path. will update renewal tracker. :thumbsup:
